rebuild_prerequisites.derived_inputs: fresh extraction produces the five raw_tsvs and building_culture_variants__.loc declared above; copy vanilla/00/db to extract/00/db, never link a mutable sibling cache
rebuild_prerequisites.input_directory: ALFRED_REBUILD_INPUTS must name an absolute read-only directory containing byte-identical db.pack, local_en.pack, schema_wh3.ron, appmanifest_1142710.acf; these are the only external data inputs
rebuild_prerequisites.registry: tracked data/rules.json and data/purpose_labels_vanilla.json are required prebuilt inputs for all 1,943 assertions, not regenerated semantic proof; tracked data/recruitment_role_policy_vanilla.json and data/recruitment_source_vanilla.json are required byte-bound role inputs; preserve the bound rulebook after extraction
rebuild_prerequisites.tools: python3 and rpfm_cli on PATH; run the recipe in one shell from a checkout with no .cache/extract or .cache/provenance/home

rebuild_recipe:
python3 - <<'PY'
import hashlib, json, os, shutil
from pathlib import Path
inputs = Path(os.environ['ALFRED_REBUILD_INPUTS'])
assert inputs.is_absolute(), 'ALFRED_REBUILD_INPUTS must be absolute'
assert not Path('.cache/extract').exists(), 'recipe requires a fresh extraction cache'
home = Path('.cache/provenance/home')
assert not home.exists(), 'recipe requires a fresh owned HOME'
labels = json.loads(Path('data/purpose_labels_vanilla.json').read_text())
manifest = labels['coverage']['source_manifest']
for identity in manifest['tracked_recruitment_inputs'].values():
    source = Path(identity['evidence_id'])
    assert source.is_file(), 'missing declared tracked input: ' + str(source)
    assert source.stat().st_size == identity['bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == identity['sha256'], 'wrong declared tracked input bytes: ' + str(source)
steam = home / 'Library/Application Support/Steam/steamapps'
game = steam / 'common/Total War WARHAMMER III/TotalWarhammer3Data/data'
for name, identity, digest, destination in (
    ('db.pack', manifest['db_pack'], 'raw_packed_file_sha256', game / 'db.pack'),
    ('local_en.pack', manifest['localization']['source_pack'], 'raw_packed_file_sha256', game / 'local_en.pack'),
    ('schema_wh3.ron', manifest['schema'], 'schema_sha256', Path('.cache/schemas/schema_wh3.ron')),
    ('appmanifest_1142710.acf', manifest['appmanifest'], 'appmanifest_sha256', steam / 'appmanifest_1142710.acf'),
):
    source = inputs / name
    assert source.is_file(), 'missing declared input: ' + name
    assert source.stat().st_size == identity['bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == identity[digest], 'wrong declared input bytes: ' + name
    destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    shutil.copyfile(source, destination)
rules = Path('data/rules.json')
assert hashlib.sha256(rules.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == labels['rulebook_sha256'], 'wrong prebuilt rulebook'
shutil.copyfile(rules, '.cache/provenance/rules.json')
PY
source_manifest.scope: 21 primary-garrison composition and localized UI evidence only; full registry assertions bind to top-level rulebook_sha256
